## Coaching Note

Your opponent's king on g6 is fatally exposed. When you capture the pawn with check (Qxg4+), White's only defense is Rg5—blocking the check. But this puts the rook on the same line as your queen, and when you capture it, the king has no escape: that's checkmate. Always scan for checks that force your opponent into a mating net. Here, the exposed king and undefended pawn on g4 were the clue.
